external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state where the colleague is located.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store who is vouched for by the franchise identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state where the franchise colleague is located.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group-membership changes and leaver information overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by the franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The text does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, pulls directory changes, and writes sign-ins to the audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that takes an identity-broker token and decides what a colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
processes.notes: This is the generic application described by the text; the store admin console is separately named.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows a holder of a token containing the store-manager group to change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker for tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a colleague after sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues an identity token to an application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.notes: The text describes applications generically; the named store admin console is modelled separately.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker supplies a token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: Token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: An application fetches the public half of the token-signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the token-signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker accesses the signing key kept in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleagues and group membership.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.notes: The broker also uses the directory when handling colleague sign-in, but the text does not describe that interaction separately.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether this covers the franchise route or what the log records.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to change prices when the token contains the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

data_flows.name: void transactions
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to void transactions when the token contains the store-manager group.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: colleague home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Devices owned by colleagues at home from which colleagues may sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home
trust_boundaries.notes: The text names these as a location from which colleagues sign in, but does not place the colleague entity itself in this boundary.

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment whose colleagues and identity provider participate in sign-in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
trust_boundaries.notes: The text does not state the runtime location of the franchise identity provider or franchise colleagues.

assumptions.assumption: The directory contains confidential information because it holds colleague records and group membership.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store contains confidential information because it holds a token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the identity broker keeps its signing key in the key store.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log contains confidential information because it records sign-ins associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.

assumptions.assumption: The store admin console presents a web interface because it is described as a console used directly by a colleague.
assumptions.basis: The source names the component as the store admin console and describes a holder using it to change prices and void transactions.
